<?php

$data = array_map('intval', preg_split('/\s+/', trim(stream_get_contents(STDIN))));
$idx = 0;

$n = $data[$idx++];
$m = $data[$idx++];

$a = [];
$b = [];

for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    $a[$i] = $data[$idx++];
}
for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    $b[$i] = $data[$idx++];
}

function popcount(int $x): int
{
    $count = 0;
    while ($x !== 0) {
        $x &= $x - 1;
        $count++;
    }
    return $count;
}

function catalanRank(int $mask, int $n, int $m): int
{
    $length = $n * $m;
    $k = intdiv($length, 2);
    $selectedResidues = popcount($mask);

    $g = ($n % 2 === 0) ? 2 : 1;
    $period = intdiv($n, $g);
    $slope = intdiv(2 * $selectedResidues - $n, $g);

    $minimum = 0;

    for ($r = 1; $r <= $period && $r <= $k; $r++) {
        $j = $r;

        if ($slope < 0) {
            $j += intdiv($k - $r, $period) * $period;
        }

        $prefixLength = 2 * $j - 1;
        $fullPeriods = intdiv($prefixLength, $n);
        $remainder = $prefixLength % $n;

        $count = $fullPeriods * $selectedResidues;
        if ($remainder > 0) {
            $count += popcount($mask & ((1 << $remainder) - 1));
        }

        $value = $count - $j;
        if ($value < $minimum) {
            $minimum = $value;
        }
    }

    return $k + $minimum;
}

$answer = 0;
$deltas = [];

for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    $answer += $m * $b[$i];
    $deltas[$i] = $a[$i] - $b[$i];
}

$mask = 0;
$previousRank = 0;

for ($weight = -9; $weight <= 9; $weight++) {
    for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
        if ($deltas[$i] === $weight) {
            $mask |= 1 << $i;
        }
    }

    $currentRank = catalanRank($mask, $n, $m);
    $answer += ($currentRank - $previousRank) * $weight;
    $previousRank = $currentRank;
}

echo $answer, PHP_EOL;

<?php

$data = preg_split('/\s+/', trim(stream_get_contents(STDIN)));
$idx = 0;

$n = (int)$data[$idx++];
$m = (int)$data[$idx++];

$a = [];
$b = [];
$delta = [];

for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    $a[$i] = (int)$data[$idx++];
}

$sumB = 0;
for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    $b[$i] = (int)$data[$idx++];
    $sumB += $b[$i];
    $delta[$i] = $a[$i] - $b[$i];
}

if (($n & 1) === 0) {
    $period = intdiv($n, 2);
    $cycles = $m;
} else {
    $period = $n;
    $cycles = intdiv($m, 2);
}

$totalSelected = intdiv($n * $m, 2);
$previousCumulative = 0;
$selectedCost = 0;

for ($threshold = -9; $threshold <= 9; $threshold++) {
    $shift = 0;
    $minimum = null;

    for ($k = 0; $k < $period; $k++) {
        $rightResidue = ($n - 1 - (2 * $k) % $n + $n) % $n;
        $leftResidue = ($n - 2 - (2 * $k) % $n + 2 * $n) % $n;

        $rightGreater = ($delta[$rightResidue] > $threshold) ? 1 : 0;
        $leftGreater = ($delta[$leftResidue] > $threshold) ? 1 : 0;

        $stepShift = $rightGreater + $leftGreater - 1;
        $stepMinimum = $leftGreater;

        if ($minimum === null) {
            $minimum = $stepMinimum;
        } else {
            $minimum = max($stepMinimum, $minimum + $stepShift);
        }

        $shift += $stepShift;
    }

    if ($shift > 0) {
        $deficit = max(
            $minimum + ($cycles - 1) * $shift,
            $cycles * $shift
        );
    } else {
        $deficit = $minimum;
    }

    $cumulative = $totalSelected - $deficit;
    $countAtThreshold = $cumulative - $previousCumulative;
    $selectedCost += $countAtThreshold * $threshold;
    $previousCumulative = $cumulative;
}

$answer = $m * $sumB + $selectedCost;
echo $answer, PHP_EOL;

<?php

$data = array_map('intval', preg_split('/\s+/', trim(stream_get_contents(STDIN))));
$pos = 0;

$n = $data[$pos++];
$m = $data[$pos++];

$a = [];
$sumA = 0;
for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    $a[$i] = $data[$pos++];
    $sumA += $a[$i];
}

$weight = [];
for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    $b = $data[$pos++];
    $weight[$i] = $a[$i] - $b;
}

$periodPairs = ($n % 2 === 0) ? intdiv($n, 2) : $n;
$cycles = ($n % 2 === 0) ? $m : intdiv($m, 2);

$pairX = [];
$pairY = [];
for ($i = 0; $i < $periodPairs; $i++) {
    $pairX[$i] = $weight[(2 * $i) % $n] + 9;
    $pairY[$i] = $weight[(2 * $i + 1) % $n] + 9;
}

$counts = array_fill(0, 19, 0);
$remaining = $cycles;

while ($remaining > 0) {
    $start = $counts;
    $events = [];

    for ($i = 0; $i < $periodPairs; $i++) {
        $counts[$pairX[$i]]++;

        $minimum = 0;
        while ($counts[$minimum] === 0) {
            $minimum++;
        }

        $events[] = [$minimum, $counts[$minimum]];
        $counts[$minimum]--;

        $counts[$pairY[$i]]++;
    }

    $delta = [];
    for ($i = 0; $i < 19; $i++) {
        $delta[$i] = $counts[$i] - $start[$i];
    }

    $repeat = $remaining;

    foreach ($events as [$category, $available]) {
        for ($lower = 0; $lower < $category; $lower++) {
            if ($delta[$lower] !== 0) {
                $repeat = 1;
                break 2;
            }
        }

        if ($delta[$category] < 0) {
            $limit = intdiv($available - 1, -$delta[$category]) + 1;
            if ($limit < $repeat) {
                $repeat = $limit;
            }
        }
    }

    if ($repeat < 1) {
        $repeat = 1;
    }

    if ($repeat > 1) {
        for ($i = 0; $i < 19; $i++) {
            $counts[$i] = $start[$i] + $repeat * $delta[$i];
        }
    }

    $remaining -= $repeat;
}

$saved = 0;
for ($i = 0; $i < 19; $i++) {
    $saved += $counts[$i] * ($i - 9);
}

$answer = $m * $sumA - $saved;
echo $answer, PHP_EOL;

<?php

$data = array_map('intval', preg_split('/\s+/', trim(stream_get_contents(STDIN))));
$idx = 0;

$n = $data[$idx++];
$m = $data[$idx++];

$a = [];
$b = [];
$delta = [];

for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    $a[$i] = $data[$idx++];
}

$baseCost = 0;
for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    $b[$i] = $data[$idx++];
    $baseCost += $b[$i] * $m;
    $delta[$i] = $a[$i] - $b[$i];
}

$gcd = ($n % 2 === 0) ? 2 : 1;
$period = intdiv($n, $gcd);
$repetitions = intdiv($n * $m, 2 * $period);
$totalSlots = intdiv($n * $m, 2);

$rankForThreshold = function (int $threshold) use (
    $n, $delta, $period, $repetitions
): int {
    $allowed = [];
    for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
        $allowed[$i] = ($delta[$i] <= $threshold) ? 1 : 0;
    }

    $cycle = [];
    $totalArrivals = 0;

    for ($t = 0; $t < $period; $t++) {
        $left = (2 * $t - 1) % $n;
        if ($left < 0) {
            $left += $n;
        }
        $right = (2 * $t) % $n;
        $cycle[$t] = $allowed[$left] + $allowed[$right];
        $totalArrivals += $cycle[$t];
    }

    $queue = 0;
    $matched = 0;

    for ($t = 0; $t < $period; $t++) {
        $arrivals = ($t === 0) ? $allowed[0] : $cycle[$t];

        if ($queue + $arrivals > 0) {
            $queue += $arrivals - 1;
            $matched++;
        }
    }

    $remaining = $repetitions - 1;

    while ($remaining > 0) {
        $before = $queue;
        $cycleMatched = 0;

        for ($t = 0; $t < $period; $t++) {
            $arrivals = $cycle[$t];

            if ($queue + $arrivals > 0) {
                $queue += $arrivals - 1;
                $cycleMatched++;
            }
        }

        $matched += $cycleMatched;
        $remaining--;

        if ($remaining === 0) {
            break;
        }

        if ($cycleMatched === $period && $totalArrivals >= $period) {
            $matched += $remaining * $period;
            break;
        }

        if ($queue === $before) {
            $matched += $remaining * $cycleMatched;
            break;
        }
    }

    return $matched;
};

$previousRank = 0;
$openAdjustment = 0;

for ($weight = -9; $weight <= 9; $weight++) {
    $rank = $rankForThreshold($weight);
    $openAdjustment += ($rank - $previousRank) * $weight;
    $previousRank = $rank;

    if ($rank === $totalSlots) {
        break;
    }
}

echo ($baseCost + $openAdjustment), PHP_EOL;

<?php

$data = array_map('intval', preg_split('/\s+/', trim(stream_get_contents(STDIN))));
$p = 0;

$n = $data[$p++];
$m = $data[$p++];

$a = [];
$b = [];
$baseCost = 0;

for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    $a[$i] = $data[$p++];
    $baseCost += $m * $a[$i];
}

for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    $b[$i] = $data[$p++];
}

$diff = [];
for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    $diff[$i] = $b[$i] - $a[$i];
}

$blocks = intdiv($m, 2);
$previousRank = 0;
$extraCost = 0;

for ($cost = -9; $cost <= 9; $cost++) {
    $selectedPerPeriod = 0;
    for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
        if ($diff[$i] <= $cost) {
            $selectedPerPeriod++;
        }
    }

    $selected = 0;
    $maxExcess = 0;

    for ($length = 1; $length <= 2 * $n; $length++) {
        $residue = ($length - 1) % $n;
        if ($diff[$residue] <= $cost) {
            $selected++;
        }

        $excess = $selected - intdiv($length, 2);
        if ($excess > $maxExcess) {
            $maxExcess = $excess;
        }
    }

    $drift = 2 * $selectedPerPeriod - $n;
    if ($drift > 0) {
        $maxExcess += ($blocks - 1) * $drift;
    }

    $totalSelected = $m * $selectedPerPeriod;
    $rank = $totalSelected - $maxExcess;

    $extraCost += $cost * ($rank - $previousRank);
    $previousRank = $rank;
}

echo ($baseCost + $extraCost) . PHP_EOL;

Write a program in PHP to solve this programming problem:
Description: Jeff loves regular bracket sequences.Today Jeff is going to take a piece of paper and write out the regular bracket sequence, consisting of nm brackets. Let's number all brackets of this sequence from 0 to nm - 1 from left to right. Jeff knows that he is going to spend ai mod n liters of ink on the i-th bracket of the sequence if he paints it opened and bi mod n liters if he paints it closed.You've got sequences a, b and numbers n, m. What minimum amount of ink will Jeff need to paint a regular bracket sequence of length nm?Operation x mod y means taking the remainder after dividing number x by number y.
Input Specification: The first line contains two integers n and m (1 ≤ n ≤ 20; 1 ≤ m ≤ 107; m is even). The next line contains n integers: a0, a1, ..., an - 1 (1 ≤ ai ≤ 10). The next line contains n integers: b0, b1, ..., bn - 1 (1 ≤ bi ≤ 10). The numbers are separated by spaces.
Output Specification: In a single line print the answer to the problem — the minimum required amount of ink in liters.

Sample Input:
2 6
1 2
2 1
Sample Output:
12

Sample Input:
1 10000000
2
3
Sample Output:
25000000

Notes: NoteIn the first test the optimal sequence is: ()()()()()(), the required number of ink liters is 12.
Take input from standard input and output to standard output
Provide the PHP code without any extra description or tokens. Target code:
